text:
Galvanising prevents iron from rusting.
Which statements about galvanising are correct?
1
Galvanising involves coating the iron with silver.
2
Galvanising prevents oxygen and water from coming into contact with the iron.
3
Galvanising works because the metal coating loses electrons more readily than iron.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 3 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
2 only
subject: Chemistry

content.text: Which statements about galvanising are correct?

content.html: Galvanising involves coating the iron with silver. Galvanising prevents oxygen and water from coming into contact with the iron. Galvanising works because the metal coating loses electrons more readily than iron.
